newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down, investors remain shaky.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down, investors remain shaky.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down for the fourth consecutive session on Monday as investors remained shaky over likely losses by companies, brokers said.
"Investors were panicked by the government's failure to ensure power supply to industries and non-implementation of stock-related financial directives," one broker said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share index shed 46.75 points or 3.17 percent at 1,423.47 on a turnover of 76.1 million taka. Singer Bangladesh lost 680 taka to 9,798, Shine Pukur Holdings shed 2.46 to 234.92 and Reckitt & Colman was up 4.47 to 245.29.
